items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: I came right straight to his house. Yeah, and his wife said, how you find this place?

ctx.x: His brother-in-law knows me because I come from Missouri, you see? He came from Missouri. So he told him, maybe you could get a fella I know to play trump with you. So there we sent him. But I was already down here with him. I lived on Cryo Street. See? So I got the letter and I came on him. Told me, you know, direct me just had to come, you know. I caught the ferry, Connelly Tree's ferry, came down. I walked all the way down from the ferry to the fire department there, you know? Walking up two blocks and then I…
